name: DREAMM
description:
DREAMM is an emulator and preservation engine created by Aaron Giles dedicated to LucasArts graphic adventure and arcade games. It provides an authentic, plug-and-play experience for classic titles using the SCUMM engine, GrimE, and FM-Towns hardware.

Features:
- One-click launching of classic LucasArts adventures with zero configuration needed
- Supports SCUMM engine titles, GrimE 3D adventures, and FM-Towns releases
- Pixel-accurate graphics scaling with authentic CRT emulation options
- Accurate sound synthesis and digital audio playback
- Integrated game manager that organizes and preserves your classic collection
